added.title: Vice President, Product Management, Stablecoins and Open Standard
added.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Vice President, Product Management, Stablecoins and Open Standard

Overview

Mastercard's Blockchain and Digital Assets group drives Mastercard’s business and product strategy in the digital currency payment space. The team is at the heart of making Mastercard the trusted access layer that lets regulated institutions and their customers enable real-time payments and smart money movement through stablecoins, tokenized deposits and other forms of tokenized value.

We are looking for a Vice President, Product Management to lead the design, development, and implementation of innovative blockchain and digital asset solutions, with a primary focus on onboarding, enabling and operationalizing various stablecoins, including Open Standard, onto Mastercard’s suite of products through direct relationships and integrations with stablecoin issuers. The role has global responsibilities and supports the execution of Mastercard's broader crypto and blockchain product roadmap.

The ideal candidate is a strong leader and people manager who combines deep payments expertise with strong product development, partnership management, commercialization, and business leadership experience. The candidate should possess a proven ability to bring innovative products from concept to market, build strategic ecosystem relationships, negotiate complex commercial arrangements, and drive adoption at scale, while maintaining a genuine passion for the digital asset space.

Role

Lead Mastercard's strategic relationship with Open Standard and its member ecosystem, serving as a senior commercial, product, and governance representative to drive alignment on product strategy, ecosystem growth, operating models, and long-term network objectives.
Represent Mastercard in Open Standard governance and strategic decision-making, helping shape product roadmap, commercialization models, operating frameworks, and market expansion initiatives while ensuring alignment with Mastercard's strategic, regulatory, and network objectives.
Lead the development and commercialization of Mastercard's wholesale on- and off-ramp capabilities, enabling regulated financial institutions and Open Standard participants to efficiently mint, redeem, custody, and move tokenized money between fiat and blockchain-based networks at scale.
Drive strategic partnerships with stablecoin issuers, financial institutions, fintechs, infrastructure providers, and other ecosystem participants to expand Mastercard's stablecoin capabilities, accelerate market adoption, and create mutually beneficial commercial outcomes.
Lead negotiations with Stablecoin Issuers and issuers of other tokenized forms of money globally to ensure alignment, commercial viability and enablement of existing and new Mastercard products and services such as remittances, payouts, and B2B payments.
Drive the successful adoption, growth, and commercialization of Open Standard and other compliant stablecoins across Mastercard products and services by identifying new use cases, distribution opportunities, customer segments, and ecosystem partnerships.
Lead product and business engagements with third-party and distributed blockchains to facilitate payment product enablement and mutually beneficial business outcomes.
Develop innovative solution concepts that have strategic fit and value for Mastercard's customers and partners, including ideation, definition, design, and development of blockchain and digital asset solutions.

All About You

Partnership management: Proven experience building and managing strategic partnerships, including commercial negotiations, relationship management, ecosystem development, and execution with financial institutions, fintechs, technology providers, or digital asset participants
Blockchain and digital assets knowledge: Strong knowledge of and interest in the blockchain, crypto, and digital asset space. Experience building and contributing to well-known blockchain or crypto projects is desirable
Payments expertise: Experience in the payments industry with in-depth understanding of payment solutions across a variety of market segments, including familiarity with relevant industry standards and regulatory requirements. Treasury and transaction banking experience a plus.
Product development: Experience in bringing new products to market, including concept definition and validation, business requirements definition, and comfort working in cross-functional teams, in line with established product development processes
Commercialization: Demonstrated success bringing new products and capabilities to market, including developing go-to-market strategies, pricing and business models, customer acquisition plans, partner enablement programs, and adoption growth initiatives.
Commercial acumen: Good commercial insight with experience building value propositions for all participants in a payments ecosystem, including Mastercard, our customers, and partners
Communication skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify and describe complex concepts and technologies to audiences of varied knowledge, and to communicate vision and roadmap effectively to a wide variety of stakeholders
Entrepreneurial mindset: A strong entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to learn quickly, adapt to a changing market landscape, challenge the status quo, and work independently
Analytical rigor: Strong analytical skills and sound judgment with the ability to digest complex problems and take thoughtful risks
People leadership: Strong track record of leading and developing talent

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Opportunity Overview

The Director, AI Product Manager – AI Controls & Observability
is responsible for driving the end‑to‑end development and delivery of AI platform capabilities to support safe, scalable, and reliable use of AI across Edward Jones in the build, management, and retirement of AI control & observability products from ideation through launch and ongoing optimization. This role translates business needs into actionable technical requirements, leads product discovery and validation efforts, and defines success metrics to evaluate product impact.

Unlike ‑Product Managers within the Digital Product Management organization, this role treats AI itself as the product
—owning firmwide, reusable, and scalable AI platform capabilities that power AI Product Manager experiences rather than discrete applications.

This role centers on strategy, discovery, and value framing, working closely with each Business and Functional area to shape AI direction, identify high‑value opportunities, and expand the art of the possible for how AI can transform their domain. Digital Product Managers will often serve as customers of the AI Product Manager, and leverage AI Products as part of their offerings. Digital Product Managers will remain accountable for the execution, delivery, and lifecycle management of AI capabilities within products and portfolios. The Director, AI Product Manager partners closely with Digital’s Product Management teams to ensure enterprise AI capabilities can be easily integrated, adopted, and leveraged across the firm.

This role ensures the adoption of responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory expectations, while clearly communicating progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. Working in collaboration with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas , the Director, AI Product Manager – AI Control & Observability ensures that AI platform capabilities deliver measurable value, maintain performance through ongoing monitoring, and support firmwide strategic objectives through shared AI capability development. The role acts as a connector throughout the full product lifecycle—navigating ideation, discovery, delivery, adoption, and iteration.

This position sits within the AI Platform Team
inside EJ Labs
, focused on building and managing the reusable AI platform capabilities that enable teams across the enterprise to clearly identify, observe, evaluate, and operate AI products through a consistent, standards-based ecosystem, rather than developing one-off or front-end solutions.

What You'll Do

Translate business needs into clear and actionable technical requirements for AI Products - reusable AI capabilities.
Lead product discovery, validation, and iterative improvement processes with a focus on how AI control & observability products are embedded across many applications, tools, and internal teams.
Define and track product success metrics specific to AI control & observability product performance, reusability, adoption, and ongoing monitoring.
Conduct research and engage internal customers to inform AI platform capabilities.
Ensure responsible AI practices and compliance with regulatory requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
Drive the development and delivery of AI platform capabilities, ensuring they are not one-off builds, but reusable, model driven products deployed across the organization.
Collaborate with colleagues in EJ Labs, Engineering, Data, Product Management, Experience, and the respective Business and Functional areas teams to test, deploy, and refine new AI platform capabilities and ensure alignment with enterprise AI standards.
Communicate product progress, updates, and outcomes to stakeholders across the organization.
Conduct market and user research to understand demand for reusable AI capabilities and anticipate model and agent centric enhancements.
Monitor and evaluate AI platform capability performance, implementing refinements as needed as part of ongoing product lifecycle management and governance.
Actively shape the definition and evolution of product AI capability vision and strategy in partnership with business and technology stakeholders to drive measurable business impact and outcome-oriented delivery.
Translate business goals, user insights, market trends, and product model and agent knowledge into product AI roadmaps, themes, initiatives, epics, and user stories—informing prioritization and hypothesis generation in collaboration with partners.
Support product delivery, adoption, and business impact through influence and collaboration, reinforcing outcome ownership while navigating shared accountability.
Collaborate with product leadership, delivery partners, and enabling teams to support resource coordination, delivery execution, and risk management across delivery teams.
Deploy and test new AI platform builder capabilities, ensuring reliability, explainability, and functional integration with a broad set of consuming systems and applications.
Own the lifecycle of AI platform builder capabilities—including versioning, performance monitoring, retraining plan development, and continuous improvement.
Ensure EJ Labs’ AI platform capabilities are adopted by internal customers.

What You Will Need

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, product management or related field.
7+ years’ experience in product management includes translating business needs into technical requirements and leading product discovery and validation.
3+ years' experience in AI/ML.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and financial services.
Product operating model methodologies, including AI driven PDLC.
AI technologies and their applications in business contexts.
Metrics and frameworks for tracking product AI model and agent success and impact.
Responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance requirements.
User experience (UX) principles and their integration into product AI capability design.

Master’s Degree in Artificial Intelligence, Product Management, or a related field.
5+ years’ experience in AI product management, with a focus on responsible AI practices and regulatory compliance in a financial services context.
Financial services industry practices and regulations.
Emerging trends in AI product model and agent development and management.
Data governance and integrity management.
Risk management and compliance in AI product AI model and agent development.
Advanced data visualization techniques for product insights.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Images is a visual discovery platform, helping people explore, evaluate, and understand the world visually every day. As generative AI and multimodal models fundamentally change how people search, visual experiences have become one of the most dynamic and high-priority frontiers in Google Search.

As a Product Manager, you will manage the strategy, roadmap, and user experience across core visual search surfaces on mobile and desktop. Working at the intersection of consumer UX and AI, you will reimagine how people browse, inspect, and interact with visual results, helping users seamlessly move from broad, open-ended exploration to understanding and real-world utility. You will partner with Engineering, Research, UX, and cross-functional leaders across Search, Shopping, and Advertising to shape product direction, deliver high-visibility initiatives, and produce modern visual experiences at scale.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Job Title

Vice President of Product Design 

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Vice President of Product Design is responsible for leading the company's overall product design strategy, design organization, and user experience vision.

This role oversees product design, user experience, user interface, design systems, customer research, and design innovation across the company's products and services.

The VP of Product Design serves as a strategic bridge between business strategy, product management, technology, customer insights, and design, ensuring that products are intuitive, differentiated, scalable, and aligned with customer and business objectives.

The position is accountable for establishing a strong design vision, improving customer experience, accelerating product innovation, and building a world-class product design organization.

Key Responsibilities
I. Product Design Strategy

Develop and execute the company's product design strategy in alignment with corporate and product objectives.

Establish design principles, standards, processes, priorities, and long-term design roadmaps.

Translate business and customer requirements into clear product design strategies.

Ensure design is integrated into product strategy and business decision-making.

II. Product Experience and User Experience

Lead the development of intuitive, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

Oversee user experience (UX), user interface (UI), interaction design, information architecture, and customer journey design.

Identify opportunities to improve usability, accessibility, customer satisfaction, and overall product experience.

Establish user-centered design practices throughout the product development lifecycle.

III. Design Research and Customer Insights

Develop research strategies to understand customer needs, behaviors, preferences, and pain points.

Oversee user research, usability testing, customer interviews, surveys, and other research activities.

Translate customer insights and behavioral data into actionable product and design recommendations.

Partner with Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to maintain a strong understanding of target customers.

IV. Product Development Collaboration

Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, and Business teams throughout the product development process.

Ensure design requirements and user experience objectives are incorporated from product concept through launch.

Participate in product planning, prioritization, prototyping, testing, and product reviews.

Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business requirements, and design quality.

V. Design Systems and Standards

Establish and maintain scalable design systems, visual standards, interaction patterns, and design guidelines.

Ensure consistent product experiences across platforms, products, regions, and customer touchpoints.

Improve design efficiency through reusable components, standardized processes, and modern design tools.

Promote accessibility, usability, consistency, and quality across the company's product portfolio.

VI. Innovation and Emerging Design Technologies

Lead design innovation initiatives that improve product differentiation and customer experience.

Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Explore the use of artificial intelligence, automation, advanced prototyping, analytics, and other technologies to improve the design process.

Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous product experience improvement.

VII. Design Quality and Product Excellence

Establish design quality standards and review mechanisms across the organization.

Conduct design reviews and provide strategic direction for major products and customer experiences.

Identify design risks, usability issues, and experience gaps and develop improvement strategies.

Ensure product experiences meet appropriate quality, accessibility, usability, and brand standards.

VIII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with Executive Leadership, Product, Engineering, Technology, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Research, and other business functions.

Create effective collaboration mechanisms between designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders.

Ensure design decisions support product strategy, customer requirements, brand positioning, and commercial objectives.

Represent the design organization in major strategic and product decisions.

IX. Design Organization and Resource Management

Develop and manage the product design organization, including UX designers, UI designers, interaction designers, researchers, design system specialists, and design leaders.

Establish organizational structures, resource allocation models, workflows, and performance objectives.

Manage design budgets, external design partners, agencies, tools, and other resources.

Ensure design resources are aligned with strategic product priorities.

X. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a high-performing product design organization.

Develop senior design leaders, design managers, researchers, and individual contributors.

Establish talent development, succession planning, career frameworks, and performance management systems.

Foster a culture of customer-centricity, creativity, collaboration, innovation, experimentation, and design excellence.

Qualifications

Description & Requirements

Join Our Team and Make a Difference!

Are you looking for an impactful role where you finish the workday knowing you helped someone? Whether you are part of our care coordination team or play a supporting role, the work our colleagues do every day enables us to collectively reach our mission of getting people the care they need when they need it.
By staying committed to our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply
,we can positively impact the lives of the injured workers we serve and get them back to the things that matter most in life.

Salary Range

This compensation range considers a wide range of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate is not adjusted for geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. At One Call, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What We Provide in Return for Your Commitment to Our Mission

We offer a vast array of benefits to help support the whole you, including:

Remote Work: We are a remote-first company, and almost all positions receive the flexibility of working from home.
Generous Time Off: Besides 8 company holidays and 2 personal days every year, all colleagues receive a minimum of 18 days of paid time off.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Including medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance; 401(k) matching program; and company-paid life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage.
Supportive Services: Just like our colleagues get injured workers the care they need when they need it, we want to do the same for our colleagues in their time of need. We offer a Colleague Assistance Program that provides free counseling and financial services, and our One Call Foundation, a non-profit arm of our company, provides colleagues financial assistance during times of unexpected hardships.

Job Summary

The Principal Product Manager is a senior product leadership role accountable for driving multi-vertical platform strategy at One Call and translating it into measurable enterprise value. This role owns a portfolio that spans multiple lines of business (e.g., Physical Therapy, Diagnostics, Home Health) and unifies them under a cohesive vision for critical customer and operational journeys. The Principal Product Manager leads through influence and direct / indirect leadership of Senior/Staff/Associate PMs, partnering with Engineering, Design, Operations, Data/Analytics, and Commercial functions to deliver scalable automation, integration, and market expansion. Success is defined by accelerated revenue growth, substantial efficiency gains via elimination of manual entry across front- and back-office workflows, and diversification into adjacent verticals—prioritizing viability and time-to-impact.

Principal Product Managers are expected to lead product initiatives from ideation, story creation, delivery, launch and iteration, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and time to impact. They work closely with engineering, design, operations, and other stakeholders, to understand the business processes, underlying technologies and business objectives in order to build products that are intuitive, scalable, and aligned with company goals. This role requires a strong mix of strategic thinking, user empathy, technical fluency, and excellence.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Product Strategy: Develop and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy aligned with business goals, customer needs and quantified impacts with little guidance and direction from VP of Product.
Understand Customer Needs: Conducts user research, analyze data, and gather feedback to identify pain points and opportunities across tools, processes, and experiences; collaborates with key customers to identify emerging needs.
Prioritize Features and Roadmap: Create and maintain product roadmaps that balance customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact; partner with other Product Managers to offer subject matter expertise to inform their roadmaps.
Write Clear Requirements: Translate business and user needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and support to ensure successful product development and launch.
Delivery & Communications: Own the delivery of the features / initiative on the roadmap, escalating issues and blockers that arise during development, driving updates and expectations management with stakeholders and participating / leading the ceremonies as part of our product development life cycle.
Monitor Performance Metrics: Track impact / ROI by defining KPIs to evaluate product success and inform future decisions.
Partner on Go-to-Market Strategy: Work with marketing and sales to develop launch plans that resonate with target users and drive adoption.
Manage Product Lifecycle: Oversee products from ideation through development, launch, growth, and eventual sunset if needed.
Champion the User Experience: Advocate for intuitive, delightful, and accessible product experiences by partnering with user experience, conducting user research & surveys and driving rapid prototyping feedback sessions with the people using your products.
Adapt and Iterate: Continuously refine products based on feedback, performance data, and market trends to stay competitive.
Leadership: You may also lead or partner with other Product Managers if the scope of the role and/or product area warrant it.

Educational And Experience Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics) or business-related field, or equivalent education, training and relevant work experience.
10+ years of experience in product management, preferably in a technology or SaaS environment.
Proven track record of managing successful products from concept to launch.
Experience working with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.
Familiarity with modern product management tools and practices.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of product development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Lean).
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, both written and verbal.
Ability to synthesize customer insights, market data, and business goals into actionable product strategies.
Strong prioritization and decision-making skills in fast-paced environments.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with tools like Jira, Confluence, Figma, and analytics platforms.
Demonstrated ability to use data to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
Passion for solving customer problems and delivering high-impact solutions.
Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Embody core values such as Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, and Win Together.

Physical/Mental Demands & Work Environment

This position will be performed in the colleague’s home. Work-from-home requirements include the colleague’s ability to set up computer equipment within their home office.
This job is primarily sedentary and may involve repetitive motions; the colleague must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time, operate a computer and other office equipment, assess information and files stored electronically, and converse/exchange accurate information with others, simultaneously.
The colleague must be able to discern text displayed on a monitor, input data into specific fields using a keyboard, and adjust focus to distances of up to three feet.
The colleague must have the ability to learn new tasks, follow established processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, complete multiple tasks simultaneously, communicate professionally with colleagues and customers, and complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity requirement.
The colleague must be able to manage moderate to significant mental stress as a result of, but not limited to, a dynamic and heavy workload.

Please be advised that job descriptions typically change over time as business needs, job requirements, and employee skill levels change. As such, One Call retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time.

Semify is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the discovery, definition, development, and launch of complex product initiatives across our technology portfolio. This role turns customer, employee, and business needs into clear product requirements and works closely with engineering, design, operations, sales, and customer-facing teams to deliver solutions that create measurable business value.

The Senior Product Manager will own designated areas of Semify applications, lead moderate- to high-complexity initiatives from discovery through release, and help strengthen the company’s product management practices. The role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, attention to detail, and the ability to influence decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.

Semify is a values-driven company with a belief that growing together creates the freedom to be more, do more, and have more. We operate in a remote-first environment, but will give preference to candidates who operate out of Rochester, NY, Greensboro, NC, or NYC-metro area.
This senior level role comes with competitive pay opportunities, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K with matching, and more.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000 - $180,000
.

In this role, you will:
Lead customer and stakeholder discovery to identify underlying problems, clarify business needs, test assumptions, and evaluate potential solutions.
Develop clear business requirements documents, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, prototypes, and other materials needed to support moderate- and high-complexity product initiatives.
Partner with engineering to evaluate technical approaches, dependencies, risks, tradeoffs, and implementation requirements.
Collaborate with operations, sales, customer success, support, and other stakeholders to ensure product decisions account for customer needs, business impact, and operational realities.
Lead prototype, pre-production, and final-release demonstrations for assigned initiatives, explaining complex functionality and decisions clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Conduct detailed product testing and quality assurance, validate functionality against approved requirements, and help ensure products are ready for release.
Implement customer and employee satisfaction measurement practices, analyze feedback, and recommend product or process improvements based on findings.
Contribute to product prioritization, roadmap planning, product triage, queue management, backlog grooming, and Product Review Board preparation.
Support the development, improvement, and consistent application of product design standards, user experience principles, and style guides.
Identify opportunities to use automation and artificial intelligence to improve product discovery, requirements development, testing, and other product workflows.
Provide peer coaching and mentorship to the Product Manager and contribute to stronger, more consistent product management practices across the department.

Qualified candidates will have the following knowledge and skills:
At least six years of software product management experience, including ownership of complex products or features from discovery through launch.
Demonstrated strength in customer discovery, stakeholder interviews, problem definition, assumption testing, and solution evaluation.
Experience translating business and customer needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, prototypes, or business requirements documents.
Strong technical fluency and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers on architecture considerations, dependencies, feasibility, and tradeoffs.
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand how product decisions affect customers, employees, workflows, and business performance.
Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, and executive-level storytelling skills.
Experience with user experience principles and design or prototyping tools such as Figma or Sketch.
Strong product testing and quality assurance capabilities, including careful validation of functionality against requirements.
Sound business judgment and an understanding of how product decisions influence revenue, retention, sales, customer success, support, and operational efficiency.
Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, navigate competing priorities, and resolve cross-functional disagreement constructively.
High attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives in a fast-moving environment.
Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or comparable web technologies.
